description: Intentional error-handling patterns exempt from the error-hiding audit. Prefer 'function' over 'lines': line numbers shift whenever anything above them is edited, function names do not. 'lines' remains necessary for module-level sites and shell scripts, where there is no enclosing function to key on. Each entry documents WHY the pattern is appropriate. Entries are themselves audited: an exclusion matching NO finding is reported as a 'stale-exclusion' violation, because it means either the entry drifted off its target (realign it) or the code was fixed (delete it) — and a drifted entry silently exempts an innocent site while the real finding resurfaces elsewhere looking new.

exclusions.reason: FileNotFoundError is expected when config file disappears between exists() check and read (TOCTOU). Falls through to return cls() which creates a safe default. This is not hiding an error — it IS the intended fallback.
